stages.name: AUTHORIZATION
stages.meaning: buyer charge approved or platform account exists; settlement clock may start at capture
stages.same_day: possible for the charge; not bank cash

stages.name: SETTLEMENT
stages.meaning: funds available on the processor balance
stages.stripe_us: T+2 business days after capture; first payout typically 7-14 days

stages.name: BANK_AVAILABLE
stages.meaning: funds left the processor for a privately connected payout destination
stages.same_day: only after settlement plus same-day/instant payout option; bank may still delay

rails.settlement: US default 2 business days after capture; first live payout typically 7-14 days
rails.bank_available: payout from available balance to a destination added in Dashboard Payout settings; US same-day manual payout before 17:00 US/Eastern after T+2 settlement
rails.owner_only_step: connect payout destination inside official Stripe UI

rails.bank_available: standard transfer typically 1-3 business days; Instant Transfer typically minutes and charged
rails.owner_only_step: connect payout destination inside official PayPal UI

needs_bryce.need: a payout destination connected inside an official provider UI
needs_bryce.why_only_bryce: only the owner can complete provider onboarding without pasting financial data into public roads
needs_bryce.smallest_action: privately open official Stripe or PayPal payout settings and connect a destination there
needs_bryce.after: peers can list a real USD offer and measure AUTH / SETTLE / BANK_AVAILABLE
